products.name: Bonomi Lady Fingers, 200g
products.description: The Bonomi family has been baking delicious breads and confections since 1850. Often used as an accompaniment to ice-cream, custards and coffee, lady fingers are long, thin cookies designed to turn spongy when soaked in liquor or covered with ice cream. Most notably, they are the critical ingredient in tiramisu - the famous italian dessert consisting of ladyfingers soaked in espresso, mascarpone, liquor and cocoa powder.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Sicilian Marzipan, 8.8oz
products.description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Sicilian Marzipan is a rich, organic puree of almonds and cane sugar. Marzipan, an ancient confection, was likely brought to Sicily from the Middle East by crusaders. Sicilian chefs use it to create decorations for cakes. It’s also an essential ingredient in the best almond cakes and tarts.

products.name: Antico Molino Caputo "00" Chef's Flour, 1kg
products.description: Antico Molino has been producing the best flour possible in Naples, Italy since 1924. When making pizza, pasta or bread, the quality of the flour determines the quality of the finished product. Their "OO" flour is their signature product. Named "OO" for the finest setting on the mill, it is high in protein and gluten, resulting in an optimal crust with just enough moisture, crunch, and chew.

products.name: Antico Molino Caputo "00" Pasta Fresca Flour, 1kg
products.description: Antico Molino has been producing the best flour possible in Naples, Italy since 1924. When making pizza, pasta or bread, the quality of the flour determines the quality of the finished product. Their Pasta Fresca & Gnocchi flour is designed especially for these two things. It's elasticity & high protien content will produce a superior end result!

products.name: Antico Molino Caputo Bread Flour, 1kg
products.description: Neapolitan flour producer Caputo has been supplying the world’s great pizzerias with flour since 1924. If a light and airy crust is your thing, the Caputo Nuvola (translation: cloud) flour is what you want. Caputo designed the Nuvola flour for higher levels of hydration, which leads to greater dough flexibility. The result: an easy-to-stretch dough with a remarkable rise that bakes into a puffy, crisp exterior crust with good chew and a tender interior. Great for long fermentations.

products.name: Antico Molino Caputo Semolina Flour, 1kg
products.description: Antico Molino has been producing the best flour possible in Naples, Italy since 1924. Finely ground with semolina’s signature yellowish tint, this flour is ideal for traditional pastas and breads. The perfect flour to use when the distinctive color, rustic texture and flavor characteristics of semolina are desired.

products.name: Caputo Fioreglut Gluten Free Flour, 1000g
products.description:
The Antimo Caputo line of flours is one of Italy’s premium brands for authentic

Neapolitan pizza, bread, and desserts. Their Fioreglut Gluten Free Flour is a great all-

natural alternative for those allergic to or avoiding gluten. You’ll be pleasantly surprised

at how pizza crust and bread made with this flour achieve a texture and taste that

resembles traditional loaves and crusts.

products.name: Nielsen Massey Gourmet Vanilla Beans, 2pc
products.description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. Cultivated and cured on the Bourbon Island of Madagascar, each of these vanilla beans is hand-selected for its freshness and rich fragrance. The full, sweet, creamy and mellow flavor with velvety after-tones is long-lasting and found in both the bean and the seeds. Use these beans whole, or split and scrape the seeds out and add to your favorite dishes, desserts and custards. A bonus - as long as the bean is still aromatic and moist, it can be rinsed and dried for reuse!

products.name: Nielsen Massey Madagascar Vanilla Extract, 4oz
products.description: Using premium, hand-selected beans cultivated on the Bourbon Island of Madagascar, Nielsen Massey uses their proprietary cold extraction process to gently draw out and preserve the over 300 flavor compounds found in their vanilla beans. The result is a sweet, creamy, mellow flavor with velvety after-tones, perfect for cooking and baking both sweet and savory dishes. An exceptional all-purpose vanilla. One tablespoon of vanilla extract is equivalent to one vanilla bean.

products.name: Nielsen Massey Mexican Vanilla Extract, 4oz
products.description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. This Mexican vanilla extract has the spicy characteristics of nutmeg and clove, while maintaining a woody sweetness. Use this extract with chocolate, citrus fruits, and warm spices like cinnamon. Mexican vanilla also complements savory dishes involving tomato sauce, barbeque sauce, or salsa. For dessert, try adding to your cookie or cake recipes.

products.name: Nielsen Massey Pure Vanilla Bean Paste, 4oz
products.description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. Their pure Vanilla Bean Paste is crafted using their Pure Vanilla Extract and a proprietary blend of select vanilla beans. The flavor profile is a classic, rich vanilla taste, with the addition of real bean specks from the vanilla pod, providing an enticing visual for recipes like crème brûlée and ice cream. With a consistency similar to that of molasses, you can also use this to add flavor to batters or sauces without thinning them out. Recipe substitutions: 1 tablespoon vanilla extract = 1 tablespoon vanilla bean paste = 1 whole vanilla bean.

products.name: Nielsen Massey Pure Vanilla Powder, 2.5oz
products.description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. This vanilla is ideal for dry mixes, beverages and color-sensitive recipes, like icing. You can also use this to add a finishing touch to cakes, cookies, and fruit. To use as a replacement for vanilla extract in a recipe, simply measure and substitute the same amount of vanilla powder.

products.name: Nielsen Massey Tahitian Pure Vanilla Extract, 4oz
products.description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. This delicate vanilla is cold-extracted to preserve its more than 300 different flavor compounds. It's flavor profile is often described as floral and fruity with hints of anise and cherry. Since it is very susceptible to heat, it's recommended this only be used in cold applications. Add to refrigerated and frozen desserts, pastry creams, smoothies, shakes, puddings and custards.

products.name: DeLaurenti Bittersweet 60% Chocolate Chips, 8oz
products.description: These are the chocolate chips we use in our cookies. They are perfect for that application and any other, including standing up in the kitchen and popping them into your mouth in between tasks. They are bittersweet, yes, but have enough natural sweetness to be enjoyable to eat on their own. Oh, and they are next level good in any cookie you decide to make.

products.name: Faugier Chestnut Puree, 15oz
products.description: Clement Faugier chestnut puree is smooth and unsweetened and made with chestnuts from southwestern France. It can be used in a myriad of ways in cooking and baking. Use it to make your famous Mont Blanc, the dessert of sweetened chestnut purée in the form of vermicelli, topped with whipped cream. It also has savory applications as an accompaniment to roasted meats, or in soups and sauces.

products.name: India Tree Caster Sugar, 16oz
products.description: Located in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, India Tree offers an exciting assortment of quality ingredients for cooking and baking, ranging from pantry essentials to party decoratifs. Often used in baking, their caster sugar is a pantry staple. Great for cakes, cookies, meringues, custards, and mousses. Since it dissolves quickly, it's perfect for sweetening cold beverages, or sprinkling over fresh fruit.

products.name: India Tree Dark Muscovado Sugar, 16oz
products.description: Located in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, India Tree offers an exciting assortment of quality ingredients for cooking and baking, ranging from pantry essentials to party decoratifs. Their Dark Muscovado Sugar is fine and moist in texture with a strong and lingering molasses flavor. Use this when making gingerbread, chocolate cake, fudge or any recipe calling for dark brown sugar.

products.name: India Tree Demerara Sugar, 16oz
products.description: Located in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, India Tree offers an exciting assortment of quality ingredients for cooking and baking, ranging from pantry essentials to party decoratifs. This beautiful, large-grained cane sugar from Mauritius is a very versatile sugar. Pale brown in color and mild in flavor, Demerara sugar can be used in almost any application. Use it as a table sugar to sweeten breakfast cereals or coffee. It is also an excellent decoration on cookies and baked goods while adding a subtle crunchy texture.

products.name: India Tree Fondant & Icing Sugar, 12oz
products.description: Located in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, India Tree offers an exciting assortment of quality ingredients for cooking and baking, ranging from pantry essentials to party decoratifs. Their icing powdered sugar is the absolute finest commercially available confectioner's sugar. Use this for ultra silky fondants, high-gloss icings and glazes.

products.name: India Tree Light Muscovado Sugar, 16oz
products.description: Located in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, India Tree offers an exciting assortment of quality ingredients for cooking and baking, ranging from pantry essentials to party decoratifs. Their Light Muscovado Sugar is fine and moist in texture with a sweet and delicate molasses flavor. Perfect for everything that calls for light brown sugar - this includes your morning coffee & your oatmeal!

products.name: Nielsen Massey Pure Almond Extract, 2oz
products.description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas and flavors since 1907. Almond extract is one of the most popular and versatile flavors used in baking. Just a few drops adds a warm, nutty flavor to just about anything - cakes, cookies, frosting, you name it. Made with the same attention to detail that Nielsen Massey uses to create their famous vanilla extract, it the perfect flavor compliment to vanilla, chocolate, maple and butterscotch.

products.name: Valrhona Bittersweet Chocolate 70%, 8oz
products.description: Valrhona has been making premium chocolate products in Tain L'Hermitage, France since 1922. These discs are perfect for measuring and melting - making them the ideal choice for baking. Their small, uniform shape also happens to make them a great option if you need a bite or two of chocolate.

products.name: Valrhona Blonde Chocolate, 8oz
products.description: Valrhona has been making premium chocolate products in Tain L'Hermitage, France since 1922. These discs are perfect for measuring and melting - making them the ideal choice for baking. Their small, uniform shape also happens to make them a great option if you need a bite or two of chocolate. The blonde version is not as sweet as white and a little sweeter than milk with a caramel flavor. Perfect for baking, or eating on their own...with or without a disc of the dark chocolate version!

products.name: Valrhona Cocoa Powder, 6.4oz
products.description: Valrhona has been making premium chocolate products in Tain L'Hermitage, France since 1922. This powder has an intense cocoa flavor, perfect for baking and drinking chocolate, dusting a bowl of vanilla ice cream, and the occasional mole sauce.

products.name: A Butter Place Unsalted Bulk Butter
products.description: The folks behind A Butter Place started making butter as a pandemic hobby, hand-kneading each pound. Their technique is based on the old-time French style. Based in the Greenwood neighborhood of Seattle, their mission is simple: to provide high-quality, flavorful butter made from locally sourced Cream from Washington Jersey cows, enriched with real, local ingredients. Their unsalted bulk butter will take your baking to the next level!

products.name: Belgioioso Mascarpone, 16oz
products.description: In 1990, Belgioso became the first American company to start making Italian-style mascarpone. They got it right. This is your key ingredient for your famous tiramisu, Also fantastic with a myriad of other desserts and atop fresh berries!

products.name: DeLaurenti Almond Paste, 8oz
products.description: This almond paste is amazing. Ultra fragrant & flavorful. There is no substitute for this top quality, baker's grade almond paste for all your baking needs. No sugar added, that part is up to you!

products.name: DeLaurenti Candied French Lemon Strips, 4oz
products.description: These French candied lemon strips are the best. They are the ones that sit on top of your freshly prepared canoli in our cafe. They are also the ones that can be chopped up and used in cookies and eaten right from the container!

products.name: DeLaurenti Candied French Orange Strips, 4oz
products.description: These French candied orange strips are the best. They are the ones that sit on top of your freshly prepared canoli in our cafe. They are also the ones that can be chopped up and used in cookies and eaten right from the container!

products.name: Dufour Classic All Butter Puff Pastry, 14oz
products.description: We know you are capable of making really good puff pastry, but let's be honest...why would you when you can just buy this? It's buttery, flaky and perfect for everything from your famous Beef Wellington to a host of sweet & savory appetizers & desserts. Store these sheets in the freezer if you aren't going to use them right away - they thaw at room temp in just 15 minutes! Unfold them and voila!

GLUTEN FREE ADDITION!

products.name: Lars Own Belgian Pearl Sugar, 225g
products.description: For real Belgian Waffles, you will need to use this sugar. As the batter cooks in the iron, the sugar will melt and caramelize, leaving behind crispy pockets of sweetness. Enjoy your waffles like the Belgians - for breakfast, with an afternoon coffee, or as a delicious dessert topped with fresh whipped cream or melted chocolate.

products.name: LorAnn Anise Oil, 1oz
products.description: LorAnn Anise Oil is a pure, natural essential oil and is used as a flavoring as well as in aromatherapy for its licorice aroma and flavor, and its digestive benefits. This little bottle is packed with super strength - typically 4 times stronger than standard extracts, so use sparingly. Great for candies, biscotti, chocolate frosting & more. Typical use is ¼ to ½ teaspoon per pound of chocolate or dough.

products.name: Masienda Masa Taquera, 26oz
products.description: Masa Taquera, Hasienda's specialized masa for tacos, is made in Mexico from just two ingredients, non-GMO corn and alkaline water. Masa Taquera boasts a traditional, nixtamal-forward flavor that calls to mind fresh tortillas from a tortillería.

products.name: Medaglia d'Oro Instant Espresso Powder, 2oz
products.description: This is the original. The quick route to adding some extra body to the coffee you are trying to enjoy but can't because your friend doesn't make it strong enough. It is also what you use to make the coffee that you soak your ladyfingers in when making your famous tiramisu!

products.name: Plugra Salted Butter, 8oz
products.description: Plugrá uses specially selected cream with just the right amount of butterfat to produce the highest-quality European Style Butter. If you want to make great pastry, enrich sauces, or simply enjoy a piece of bread, this will help. Lightly salted & ready to go in a 1/2 pound block.
